name: Full local receipt-chain verification

historicalBaseline.name: Finkd published interim benchmark, different task suites

ledgers.verificationScope: Pinned local Ed25519 signatures, signed hash links and retained redacted payload hashes. Does not prove remote delivery or prevent simultaneous rollback of ledger and signed head.
ledgers.legacyNote: Historical receipts retain signature verification; they were not originally chained and may lack exact payload snapshots.

ledgers.verificationScope: Pinned local Ed25519 signatures, signed hash links and retained redacted payload hashes. Does not prove remote delivery or prevent simultaneous rollback of ledger and signed head.

limitations: Legacy receipts were signed individually. Their signatures are checked, but they are never represented as originally hash-chained.
Older receipts may lack exact retained payload snapshots; missing historical coverage is reported separately from cryptographic breaks.
Signed local heads detect ledger truncation against the retained head; simultaneous rollback of both local ledger and head needs an independent external anchor to detect.
Local cryptographic integrity does not prove cloud delivery, billing or answer accuracy.
